sections.title: About – EduTube
sections.excerpt: About - EduTube EduTube EduTube Home About Blog Games Search Login Sign Up EduTube Login Sign Up Home About Blog Games Search About EduTube About We are a bunch of fans of old and new educational games, ranging in age from 4 to 40. Educated from pre-school to PhD in education, we try to give a fair view of the different games from our different perspectives. In our carefully curated collection, we feature only the best. And we have quite a different take on what is educational. A lot of games classified as ‘educational' are not very stimulating. A lot of very stimulating games, requiring 21st century skills and thinking, are not typically classified as ‘educational'. On this website, we feature only games we think are truly educational, regardless of what category or genre they are typically placed in.
